summary.en: Tencent CraftBuddy (游点灵, craft.qq.com) as a magpie provider: sign in by pasting a cookie or from a one-off browser window. Every model in the account's menu becomes available — Auto, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and the Hunyuan Hy4 pair — with the real credit balance, the daily login grant, and every expiry batch. No browser or desktop client needed for chat.
summary.zh: 把腾讯游点灵（CraftBuddy）接进 magpie：粘贴 Cookie 或让插件开一个临时窗口扫码登录。账号菜单里的全部模型都会出现（Auto、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、混元 Hy4 两档），卡片上显示真实积分余额、每日登录赠送状态和各批次过期日。模型调用、积分查询、模型列表都不需要开着浏览器。
